NHAI floats tenders for Amaravati Outer Ring Road project

The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has floated tenders worth Rs 11,538 crore for the Amaravati Outer Ring Road project. This development comes as N. Chandrababu Naidu, reportedly targeting Rs 2,000 crore worth of Amaravati capital works monthly, is pushing for the Outer Ring Road.
